items.html: And from the Avira issued the thirteen corrections, which are the thirteen other locks of hair, mentioned on page 129, side A. And from the Mocha issued the thirteen other corrections, and they are within the Mocha itself, which is divided three times into four-four, as mentioned in the Idra of Ha'azinu, page 288, side B. Now we shall first explain the matter of these three times thirteen, that are in the three aforementioned heads; and in the chapters that follow we shall explain the matter of the thirteen corrections of the beard that are drawn from the hidden Mocha.
